newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa-UAP no comment on Benson resignation.
newsitem.headline: Axa-UAP no comment on Benson resignation.

text.p: The chairman of French insurer Axa-UAP said on Wednesday he had no comment on the decision by James Benson to resign as head of Equitable Life, the main insurance unit of its U.S. subsidiary Equitable Cos Inc.
Claude Bebear said there were "a lot of people with talent" to succeed Benson. The Axa-UAP chairman was speaking at a news conference at which the group's 1996 results were released.
Benson's resignation as president and chief executive officer of Equitable Life Assurance Society of the U.S. takes effect on May 1.
Besonson said that he was resigning to "move on to new opportunities".
Joseph Melone, president and chief executive officer of Equitable Cos and chairman of Equitable Life, will assume Benson's responsibilities on an interim basis.
